evidence.claim: The review said more than 2,700 Party organizations and nearly 168,000 Party members had been disciplined for graft, with 19,546 corruption cases prosecuted and VND 61 trillion recovered.
evidence.title: Party leader presides over national conference to review 10 years of anti-corruption
evidence.excerpt: The review said more than 2,700 Party organizations and nearly 168,000 Party members had been disciplined for graft, with 19,546 corruption cases prosecuted and VND 61 trillion recovered.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official government summary with specific quantitative results from the anti-corruption system.
evidence.period_fit: Published in 2022 and explicitly summarizing the target-period anti-corruption record.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect but meaningful: Trọng chaired the conference and headed the anti-corruption apparatus, though implementation ran through the party-state system.
contrary_evidence: The numbers are system-level and do not prove Trọng's personal finances or truthfulness.
Official reporting may emphasize successes over limits.

evidence.claim: Trọng refuted rumors that the anti-corruption drive was an internal purge or factional struggle and said it was an enduring policy.
evidence.title: Anti-corruption drive - an irreversible trend in Vietnam, says Party leader
evidence.excerpt: Trọng refuted rumors that the anti-corruption drive was an internal purge or factional struggle and said it was an enduring policy.
evidence.source_locator: lead and body paragraph summarizing his speech
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct speech report from a state broadcaster, but still mediated and politically interested.
evidence.period_fit: Directly in 2022 and about his public justification of the campaign.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct statement by Trọng; useful for motive and truthfulness claims, though self-serving.
contrary_evidence: Other analysts argued the campaign also had a factional function.
A denial of factional motive is not independent proof.

evidence.claim: Trọng ordered Party committees and agencies to intensify anti-corruption work through stronger inspection, supervision, audit, prosecution, and punishment, with no forbidden zone or exception.
evidence.title: Party chief orders more drastic actions against corruption
evidence.excerpt: Trọng ordered Party committees and agencies to intensify anti-corruption work through stronger inspection, supervision, audit, prosecution, and punishment, with no forbidden zone or exception.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct reporting of a party-chief meeting with specific policy directives and quotations.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Trọng as head of the anti-corruption apparatus.
contrary_evidence: The article is still a state-media rendering of a political meeting.
It does not establish that the campaign was apolitical.

evidence.claim: Trọng said the anti-corruption drive was for Party building and the nation's prosperity, not an internal struggle for power, and that offences must be handled with 'no forbidden zone, no exception'.
evidence.title: Anti-corruption drive strengthens nation, not internal power struggles, Party leader
evidence.excerpt: Trọng said the anti-corruption drive was for Party building and the nation's prosperity, not an internal struggle for power, and that offences must be handled with 'no forbidden zone, no exception'.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Directly quotes the ruler's explanation, but the source is mediated and the claim is self-defensive.
evidence.period_fit: Directly in 2022, tied to his public explanation of motive and ethics.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct personal statement by Trọng; relevant to honesty, commitment, and motive.
contrary_evidence: Le Monde and CSIS both suggested the campaign also served power-consolidation functions.
Self-justification does not prove benign motive.

evidence.claim: The transcript says the anti-corruption apparatus had reviewed progress since January 2022, including 11 inspection teams, 26 special checks, 498 case transfers for investigation, and discipline of 67 cadres under Politburo or Secretariat management since the start of the 13th term.
evidence.title: TOAN VAN: Ket luan cua Tong Bi thu Nguyen Phu Trong tai cuoc hop phong chong tham nhung, tieu cuc
evidence.excerpt: The transcript says the anti-corruption apparatus had reviewed progress since January 2022, including 11 inspection teams, 26 special checks, 498 case transfers for investigation, and discipline of 67 cadres under Politburo or Secretariat management since the start of the 13th term.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official full transcript with detailed numerical account of investigations and discipline.
evidence.period_fit: Exact 2022 transcript and target-period process record.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Trọng as chair of the Standing Board and speaker of the transcript; operational follow-through was institutional.
contrary_evidence: The same system can be used for factional control as well as integrity.
The transcript does not provide outside verification of each underlying case.

evidence.claim: The anti-corruption committee said 539 Party members were disciplined in 2022, including 47 officials under Politburo and Secretariat management, and more than VND 82.5 trillion and 883 hectares of land were recovered.
evidence.title: Hundreds of Party members disciplined for corruption and wrongdoings in 2022
evidence.excerpt: The anti-corruption committee said 539 Party members were disciplined in 2022, including 47 officials under Politburo and Secretariat management, and more than VND 82.5 trillion and 883 hectares of land were recovered.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Concrete year-end results report with multiple quantified outcomes from the committee's 2022 performance review.
evidence.period_fit: Retrospective on end-2022 results; still directly relevant to the target year.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Indirect but relevant: Trọng chaired the committee and the numbers reflect the apparatus under his leadership.
contrary_evidence: The report is retrospective and institutional, not a financial audit of Trọng personally.
Recovery and discipline do not prove absence of self-dealing at the top.

evidence.claim: The year-end summary said the anti-corruption drive had gathered speed under the spirit of 'no forbidden zones, no exemptions, non-stop' and that Trọng said strengthening the drive strengthened public trust in the Party, State, and administration.
evidence.title: Top 10 prominent events of Viet Nam in 2022
evidence.publisher: Báo Điện tử Chính phủ / VGP
evidence.excerpt: The year-end summary said the anti-corruption drive had gathered speed under the spirit of 'no forbidden zones, no exemptions, non-stop' and that Trọng said strengthening the drive strengthened public trust in the Party, State, and administration.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official year-end government summary quoting the party leader and describing the 2022 anti-corruption narrative.
evidence.period_fit: Directly summarizes 2022 and quotes the target-year rhetoric.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct to Trọng's public framing of the campaign; not an independent finding of personal probity.
contrary_evidence: This is a government summary of its own achievements.
It does not distinguish integrity from political consolidation.

evidence.claim: The campaign initiated by Trọng was described as serving a political function by bringing rival factions and challengers into line, with provincial steering committees expanded in May 2022 amid signs of party power struggles.
evidence.title: In Vietnam, the anti-corruption fight is in full swing
evidence.excerpt: The campaign initiated by Trọng was described as serving a political function by bringing rival factions and challengers into line, with provincial steering committees expanded in May 2022 amid signs of party power struggles.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent reporting and analysis, but still interpretive rather than a legal finding.
evidence.period_fit: Directly in 2022 and about the same campaign being evaluated that year.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attribution is to Trọng's campaign and the party environment, but the source is explicit that the political-function reading is analytical.
contrary_evidence: The article also acknowledges that the campaign targeted real corruption.
It does not prove Trọng personally benefited from the campaign.

unresolved_gaps: No direct 2022 ruler-attributed nuclear command, crisis, proliferation, or catastrophic dual-use decision is documented; the package relies on limited-exposure context and peace-oriented diplomacy.
No direct operational external-security, ceasefire-management, or war-fighting act by Trọng in 2022 is shown; the package is mostly declaratory diplomacy and restraint rhetoric.
The package does not show personally attributed incitement to communal violence or a clean ruler-led accountability reform that would offset the repression record.

Direct 2022 decision-path evidence is thin; the package leans on structural one-party baseline, media restrictions, and country reports rather than a direct record of Trọng personally directing repression.
Specific appointments of economic technocrats and household-level causal attribution remain indirect; most evidence is macro/system-level rather than personally executable by Trọng alone.
Service-delivery evidence is stronger than ruler attribution; subnational quality, regional inequality, and direct personal causal links remain thin.
There is no direct, independently verified evidence on Trọng's assets, gifts, family business interests, declaration filings, or other personal self-dealing records.
Personnel-selection evidence and direct causal attribution for program execution remain thinner than the program, implementation, and outcome record.
